xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-fin:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialR: Notes: 1.The above Audited results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at their respective meetings held on 24th June 2021. 2.The figures of the quarter ended 31st March, 2021, as reported in the financial results are the balancing figures between the audited figures in respect of full financial year ended 31st March, 2021 and published figures of nine months ended 31st December 2020. The figures for the nine months ended 31st December, 2020 have been subjected to limited review by the statutory auditors. 3.On a consolidated basis, the Company's operations and revenue during the current quarter were impacted due to COVID-19 Pandemic. During the fourth quarter of financial year 2020-21 the company has lost consolidated revenue of approx. Rs. 350 Lakhs and lost corresponding profitability. During the financial year ended 31st March, 2021, the Company lost total consolidated revenue of Rs. 1,934 Lakhs due to the impact of Covid-19 Pandemic, which also includes loss of rental income of approx. Rs. 153 Lakhs. 4.The results of the Company are available on the Company's website i.e. www.cardindia.com and also on the website of the BSE Limited i.e. www.bseindia.com and National Stock Exchange of India Limited i.e. www.nseindia.com, where the shares of the Company are listed. 5. Previous period's figures have been reclassified / regrouped wherever necessary.
